title: Albumin–RDW coupling beyond the RDW/albumin ratio: exploratory inflammation-prediction transport
abstract: Adding a source-centered albumin × RDW term beyond flexible conventional measures and RDW/albumin changed transported weighted Brier loss from 0.173758 to 0.173708 (delta -0.000050; approximate joint source/target PSU bootstrap95% [-0.000207,+0.000202]). Incremental improvement was not established. Models trained on NHANES III were transported without target tuning to separately recruited2017–2018 adults. Previously explored surveys are not untouched confirmation; this is a representation test, not a new biomarker or causal finding.
